svg.title: Lieutenant Fizz 2
svg.desc: Lieutenant Fizz: Episode 2, drawn in 16-colour EGA. A coastal night on Earth: a lighthouse sweeps a dithered beam across the sea, a magenta Zarg saucer lifts cocoa beans from a chocolate factory with a tractor beam, and Ben, alone in his green bicycle helmet, bounces on his pogo stick. The text reads Web and DOS.

g.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace
